## Description

Order composer with lab/imaging tests from order sets or search, notes (e.g. "fasting 10 h"), destination lab (free text in P2), "Place orders" action separate from note signing. CLINICAL_ORDER state Draft → Ordered; printed/PDF investigation slip. Results arrive in P4 (C-01).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Orders stay Draft until "Place orders"; placing is audited and shows state Ordered with icon + label.
- [ ] **AC2.** An investigation slip PDF can be printed/shared with patient identifiers and instructions.
- [ ] **AC3.** Orders appear on the patient timeline with state.
- [ ] **AC4.** Placing orders never happens automatically from note signing.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
